Title: Qs: Form of Mist and Wake w/Evening's Freshness

Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
A couple rules questions that I thought I knew the answers to,
but maybe not:

1. Can an acting vampire play superior Form of Mist without
using the "continue at +1 stealth" part of the effect? I
had always thought not, but card text says "can" continue
this action, so maybe so. (This came up at the Ascendance
tournament in NJ the other day. The judge went with the "can
means it's optional" theory.)

2. Iliana hunts at the usual +1 stealth. Crusher, who has
a Sport Bike, plays Wake w/Evening's Freshness and blocks her.
Iliana plays superior Form of Mist. Can Crusher try to block
again, using the same Wake, or would he need to play another
Wake?

I always thought he could block based on the same Wake, as card
text specifies "until the current action is concluded", but
several players at Ascendance had always played that he would
need a new Wake, apparently based on the "as if unblocked" text
on Form of Mist, the reasoning being that that means the first
Wake is effectively canceled.

Thanks,

Josh

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Joshua Duffin wrote:
>
> A couple rules questions that I thought I knew the answers to,
> but maybe not:
>
> 1. Can an acting vampire play superior Form of Mist without
> using the "continue at +1 stealth" part of the effect? I
> had always thought not, but card text says "can" continue
> this action, so maybe so. (This came up at the Ascendance
> tournament in NJ the other day. The judge went with the "can
> means it's optional" theory.)

The errata'ed card text doesn't say "can" [RTR 23-JUN-1998]:

Form of Mist:
New card text:
"Superior: Strike: Combat Ends. If this vampire is the acting vampire, this
vampire gets +1 stealth (and this card counts as an action modifier) and the
action continues as if unblocked."

> 2. Iliana hunts at the usual +1 stealth. Crusher, who has
> a Sport Bike, plays Wake w/Evening's Freshness and blocks her.
> Iliana plays superior Form of Mist. Can Crusher try to block
> again, using the same Wake, or would he need to play another
> Wake?
>
> I always thought he could block based on the same Wake, as card
> text specifies "until the current action is concluded", but
> several players at Ascendance had always played that he would
> need a new Wake, apparently based on the "as if unblocked" text
> on Form of Mist, the reasoning being that that means the first
> Wake is effectively canceled.

Wake's effect lasts "until the current action is concluded", as
you note.

Even as the action continues "as if unblocked", the woken vampire
is still able to "use reaction cards and attempt to block as
though untapped", by card text. [TOM 05-MAY-1995]
